prompt: Where did the writer go during the holidays?
hint: Two words or less: name the place visited.

ja.prompt: 休暇中、作者はどこに行きましたか？
ja.hint: 二語以下で：行った場所の名前を答えてください。

local.prompt: Where did the writer go during the holidays?

title: New Bicycle — Description
prompt: What does the writer say about the bicycle?
hint: Say the writer's sentence describing color and speed.
sample: It is red and very fast.

ja.prompt: 作者は自転車について何と言っていますか？
ja.hint: 色と速さを説明する作者の文で答えてください。
ja.sample: それは赤くてとても速いです。

local.prompt: What does the writer say about the bicycle?
local.hint: Say the writer's sentence describing color and speed.
local.sample: It is red and very fast.

local_pron.prompt: wut duz thuh rahy-ter say uh-bout thuh bahy-si-kuhl?
local_pron.hint: say thuh rahy-ter's sen-tuhns de-scry-bing kuh-lur and speed.
local_pron.sample: It iz red and ver-ee fast.

zh.prompt: 作者如何描述这辆自行车？
zh.hint: 用一句话说出颜色和速度的描述。

en.prompt: What does the writer say about the bicycle?
en.hint: Say the writer's sentence describing color and speed.
en.sample: It is red and very fast.

en_pron.prompt: wut duz thuh rahy-ter say uh-bout thuh bahy-si-kuhl?
en_pron.hint: say thuh rahy-ter's sen-tuhns de-scry-bing kuh-lor and speed.
en_pron.sample: It iz red and ver-ee fast.

title: Permission Letter — Request
prompt: What did the writer ask in the letter?
hint: Say the permission request: mention writing to the cousin in Tinkletown.
sample: If I can write to my cousin in Tinkletown.

ja.prompt: その手紙で作者は何を頼みましたか？
ja.hint: 許可を求める文で答えてください：Tinkletownのいとこに手紙を書くことについて。
ja.sample: Tinkletownにいるいとこに手紙を書いてよいかを尋ねました。

local.prompt: What did the writer ask in the letter?
local.hint: Say the permission request: mention writing to the cousin in Tinkletown.
local.sample: If I can write to my cousin in Tinkletown.

local_pron.prompt: wut did thuh rahy-ter ask in thuh let-er?
local_pron.hint: say thuh per-mish-un re-kwest: men-shun ryt-ing to thuh kuh-zin in Tinkletown.
local_pron.sample: If I kan ryt to my kuh-zin in Tinkletown.

zh.prompt: 作者在信中请求了什么？
zh.hint: 用一句话说明请求许可写信给住在Tinkletown的表亲。
zh.sample: 询问我是否可以给住在Tinkletown的表亲写信。

en.prompt: What did the writer ask in the letter?
